svg.title: Volcano
svg.desc: Volcano plot with fold-change and significance axes, dashed thresholds, dense neutral center, and highlighted wings. Biological basis: Volcano plots combine effect size with statistical significance so strongly changed, well-supported features appear in the upper outer regions.
